name: 7. Knowledge of Palpatine’s and Vader’s True Nature

text.content:
The Sabersworn have no idea that Emperor Palpatine is/was a Sith Lord, but have heard rumors that Darth Vader has been able to choke people from across the room and uses/used a red lightsaber, but we are unsure if he was only some high-ranking Imperial officer using the “Dark Jedi” motif for fear and propaganda.

The Sabersworn are operating under the assumption that all Jedi and Sith are gone, but they don’t exactly know how it happened, how all of it went down during Order 66. Much uncertainty surrounds the days leading up to that tragic day.

Quest Starter: Recently, the Sabersworn have decided to piece together what exactly happened that fateful day when Order 66 was issued (or perhaps is currently being issued, if you chose to play in the era when the Jedi Purge was first kicking off). The Sabersworn have just started piecing together clues about what caused the sudden attacks on the Jedi, who this Darth Vader person is, and why he chooses to pose himself as a lightsaber-wielding killer. How will you investigate the origins of “Order 66”?

The Sabersworn have no idea that Emperor Palpatine is a Sith Lord, but they are CERTAIN that Darth Vader is, and that there is one above him. They just don’t know who.

Some Sabersworn say that their intel suggests Vader was once a Jedi, but where did he come from? Others postulate that Grand Moff Tarkin is a Sith Lord holding Vader’s leash, while others suggest it could be a random, unseen enemy. It could all just be Imperial disinformation, meant to confuse us. A few Sabersworn have begun to theorize it could be (or “could have been” depending on the era you chose to play in) the Emperor himself…

Quest Starter: There was clearly a conspiracy of Sith that somehow laid in wait for centuries before destroyed the Jedi. But how? And did the Sith somehow manipulate Palpatine into believe the Jedi are/were evil, or is/was Palpatine himself a Sith? No…couldn’t be, could it? In any case, the Sabersworn have made it a primary mission to investigate to find out who the Sith Lords are/were, and if there are/were any others. How will you investigate the legacy of Darth Vader? How will you find out where he came from?

The Sabersworn are CERTAIN that both Palpatine and Vader are/were Sith Lords, but which is the master and which the apprentice? And what can be done about that? Are there other Sith in the galaxy?

Intelligence came in from a spy drone on a remote Imperial-controlled world, a private communique between Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader. The Sabersworn came into possession of this message and now have confirmation of their worst fears: the highest persons in power of the Empire are/were Sith Lords! Not only that, but Darth Vader was actually Anakin Skywalker, father of both Luke Skywalker and Princess Leia Organa of Alderaan.

Quest Starter: The only thing that matters is making sure the galaxy knows that the Sith were responsible for the rise of the Empire, and that the Sith never return. The Sabersworn must spread this knowledge far and wide, but how? How will they find convincing evidence of Palpatine’s and Vader’s treachery? And how will they spread this? And, depending on the era you’re playing in, Luke and Leia could either be children, or else heroes of the Rebellion—if the latter, how will this ruin their reputations, once it’s discovered they are connected to the greatest enemy in the galaxy?
